race.description: Atc Thank You Stable Staff C,G&E (Bm78) Hcp
race.comment: TRAPALANDA (11) went under narrowly first-up over the 1600m, then sat back in the field and never got a clear crack at them in the straight when he struck plenty of trouble to run seventh over 1900m at Canterbury. Key jockey change from the low draw and should be near his top for this. PERFECT JUSTICE (8) rewarded for his consistency as fav when he circled the field to get up late in a tight finish over 1600m at this track. Hard fit now and looks up to this with Grima's claim. TAMBELOA (10) due for a change of luck after he jumped in grade and rolled to the front before being edged out late the second over this track and trip. Nose band goes on and can play a leading role again. INQUIRING MINDS (2) fitter after two runs back and no shock to see him return to form from the good draw.
